body:
Myk commissioned this in chat (2026-08-02): loam serve should serve an admin page scoped to the container associated with the logged-in user and its children, supporting all the major operations a user would want through the browser — defining hyperschemas and schemas, creating/detaching/destroying containers, promoting deltas, federation, and managing MCP connections. Needed to test the MCP integration.

THE WORKING SPEC IS .adlc/specs/40-admin-page.md — the model (a user's world is the container named <username> plus descendants by parent edge; the session is the authority, the server signs; scope enforced at the door), the operations table, the five phases A1-A5, and the 14 acceptance criteria, each naming its rail file.

PROCESS (Myk, same message): base branch admin-page; each phase is a feature branch PR'd and merged into admin-page by the model; the whole branch is Myk's morning P6 into main. Rails declared at P3 per phase as the tests exist.

Ruled the same night: actor-role users manage their own connections (consent gating stays session-only); the admin page shows YOUR subtree to every role, one shape for everyone.
title: §40 — the admin page: a user's containers, through the browser
